title: Insurance, NPS equity investments plunge 45% to Rs 22,714 crore in September quarter
summary: Insurance companies and NPS funds have decreased their combined investments in Indian equities by 45%. They invested ₹22,714 crore in the September quarter, compared to ₹41,465 crore prior. Higher bond yields and declining stock prices have shifted their focus towards debt instruments. Mutual funds, on the other hand, continue to invest heavily in equities this quarter.

title: Sebi confirms interim curbs on Rajesh Exports, promoter over alleged fund routing
summary: Sebi has imposed interim restrictions on Rajesh Exports and its promoter Rajesh Mehta for alleged financial misrepresentation. The regulator found issues regarding the reported consolidated revenue of ₹15.4 lakh crore. Rajesh Exports' standalone revenue reported by its subsidiary Valcambi SA was significantly lower at ₹3,027.3 crore. Despite opportunities to respond, the company and promoter failed to adequately rebut Sebi’s preliminary findings.

title: RBL Bank taps Emirates NBD network to expand NRI banking, Gulf business
summary: RBL Bank aims to utilize Emirates NBD's global network to expand its corporate and trade finance services. The partnership will enable them to better serve non-resident Indians and cross-border investments. They have mobilized significant deposits and extended loans, indicating promising initial results. RBL Bank plans to explore business opportunities beyond the Gulf into markets like Singapore and Turkey.

title: Cyberattacks affect 20 financial institutions; CERT-In warns on API vulnerabilities and security measures
summary: Around 20 financial institutions were affected by cyberattacks earlier this month, with hackers allegedly exploiting stolen partner-bank credentials and vulnerabilities in payment APIs to siphon off funds. title: Govt renames NSAP as PM Samajik Sahayata Yojana, raises disability pension to  ₹375; minimum age limit removed
summary: The Union Cabinet has approved renaming the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) and revising disability pension rules. Monthly assistance will rise to  ₹375 for beneficiaries aged 0-79 and  ₹625 for those aged 80 and above, while the disability threshold drops from 80% to 40%.
